areas.name: Human rights
areas.reason: Strong alignment through violence-monitoring systems and equity institutions with clear indicators, but the area is very broad and no innovation evidence was presented.

areas.name: Women
areas.reason: General and specific objectives directly on women's economic autonomy, pay equality, care and violence prevention; well-defined indicators; resources tied to policy delivery; innovative legal measures.

areas.name: Indigenous and quilombola peoples
areas.reason: Territory titling, cultural and institutional measures with indicators, but resources are diluted across fronts and reach is moderate.

areas.name: Anti-racism
areas.reason: Structural racial-equality policies with indicators and robust design, but diluted resources and moderate reach; no evidence of innovation.

bonus.reason: Programme is fully directed at reducing structural gender and racial inequalities, matching the PPA priority on hunger and inequality reduction.
Proponent did not state the programme promotes regional integration.
